preconditions.description: The input is a single positive integer N where 1 <= N <= 20.

postconditions.expression: all(len(x) == int(stdin) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each string in the output list has a length equal to the input integer N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(x[i] in '01' for i in range(len(x))) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each string in the output list consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for c in x[:i+1] if c == '1') >= sum(1 for c in x[:i+1] if c == '0') for x in return_value for i in range(len(x)))
postconditions.description: For each string in the output list, every prefix has at least as many '1's as '0's.
The output list is sorted in decreasing lexicographical order.
